title: Air, water and food for a crew
purpose: Teach the daily oxygen, water and food one person needs (NASA BVAD), that a crew multiplies it, and why margins matter.

captions: Every day, one astronaut needs three things: air, water and food.
About {o2} kg of oxygen to breathe.
About {water} kg of water to drink, and {food} kg of food.
And they breathe out about {co2} kg of carbon dioxide.
A crew of four needs four times as much, every single day.
Without any one of the three, the crew cannot stay.
These are planning values for an average adult.
ends_on: Each shift uses a little of everything. Keep a margin, so one bad night cannot run you out.

literals.why: the crew size (four) shown as a multiplier, not a measurement
